name: Any script or tool
description: Report from your own script with blinkctl agent: any state at any moment. See docs/AGENTS.md.

install.text:
{{blinkctl}} agent --id my-tool --name "My tool" --state running --title "Working" --quiet
{{blinkctl}} agent --id my-tool --state input --title "Needs you" --quiet
{{blinkctl}} agent --id my-tool --state done --title "Finished" --quiet
{{blinkctl}} agent --id my-tool --remove --quiet
